Signs of the World

Exit

History

In 1979, Japanese graphic designer Yukio Ota created the running man for a competition held by a Japanese fire safety association. The design became an international standard in the 1980s and is now part of ISO 7010.

Adoption

The green running man guides people out of buildings from Europe to Japan. The United States is a standout, where exit signs typically use text instead of the global symbol.
